title: Better Birch
description: this removes the black dots in the birch log!
body: This is a simple, vanilla-friendly resource pack that completely removes the annoying black spots from birch bark, replacing them with a much smoother, cleaner texture that actually blends well. It keeps the classic white wood vibe of Minecraft but makes it look way cleaner and more modern, so you can actually use birch in your builds without it looking messy.
